terrainDescription.zh: 廣大草原與半沙漠地形，東南部有天山山脈
terrainDescription.en: Vast steppe and semi-desert, with the Tian Shan mountains in the southeast

plate.color: black on white (yellow for foreign-registered, red for diplomatic)
plate.shape: rectangular, 520×110mm, Kazakh flag + "KZ" band on left

roadInfra.bollardStyle: Post-Soviet/Turkish-style bollards common; a distinctive Kazakhstan-specific type is two thin bollards joined at a 90° angle

utilityPole.transformerMount: Square/rectangular concrete poles as in other post-Soviet states; street name signs are often blue plaques with white patterned borders mounted directly on buildings rather than on poles

historicalContext.zh: 主體民族為哈薩克人（突厥系遊牧文化），蘇聯時期政策使俄羅斯族移入比例較高，兩者語言／文字混用在招牌上很常見。
historicalContext.en: Majority Kazakh (Turkic nomadic heritage); Soviet-era policy brought a significant Russian-speaking population, so bilingual signage is common.
